evals.prompt: 先不要写 PRD，帮我把这个功能脑暴成几个设计方案。
evals.expected_output: Compares 2-3 options, recommends one, states tradeoffs, and asks for design confirmation before PRD or implementation.

assertions.text: Does not create a full PRD before confirmation.

evals.prompt: 参考 brainstorming，把这个桌面端需求先变成设计 spec，后面会做 mockup。
evals.expected_output: Produces design spec and includes UI discovery expectations before visual mockup.

assertions.text: Mentions downstream ui-mockup-desktop-workbench when high fidelity is needed.

evals.prompt: 我还没想清楚真正问题是什么，先帮我想想。
evals.expected_output: Routes fuzzy problem definition to calibration.

assertions.text: Does not force solution options before the problem is framed.

evals.prompt: 这个方案已经定了，帮我压力测试哪里会失败。
evals.expected_output: Routes established-solution pressure testing to grill-me.

assertions.text: Does not replace pressure testing with design brainstorming.

evals.prompt: 我们要改进 Agent 任务卡，但真正问题和判断标准还没确认；先挑战假设并校准问题，不比较解决方案。
evals.expected_output: Hands the unstable problem to calibration before comparing design options.

assertions.text: Does not brainstorm solutions before the problem and decision criteria are confirmed.

evals.prompt: 我们要改进 Agent 任务卡，真正问题和判断标准已经确认；请比较三种设计路径并收敛 design spec，不重新定义问题。
evals.expected_output: Compares three design paths and converges a design spec without reopening problem definition.

assertions.text: Selects design-option comparison after the problem and criteria are confirmed.

evals.prompt: 这个复杂任务需要多轮定题、探索、收敛和中间产物；请先规划探索路径，不把它压缩成一次问题校准。
evals.expected_output: Hands the multi-round task to complex-exploration instead of reducing it to design-option comparison.

assertions.text: Does not substitute a design-spec exercise for an explicit multi-round exploration program.

evals.prompt: 问题、目标和判断标准已经确认，但还没有成形方案；请比较 2-3 个真实设计路径并形成可确认的 Design Spec，不做压力测试。
evals.expected_output: Owns solution-option formation and produces a versioned Design Spec.

assertions.text: Creates real alternatives and a recommendation without pretending a Critic has cleared the design.

evals.prompt: 方案 DS-4/v2 已成形，scope、流程和失败恢复都已写清；现在只压力测试它的依赖、假设和失败模式，不再发散新方案。
evals.expected_output: Hands the versioned design to grill-me for focused critique.

assertions.text: Does not substitute more option generation for pressure testing an established design.

evals.prompt: Critic Handoff CH-9 针对 DS-4/v2 指出恢复流程缺少幂等状态；primary return owner 是 brainstorming，scope 和其他流程已列为 preserved items。请只修订受影响部分。
evals.expected_output: Consumes CH-9 and produces a focused Design Delta without reopening preserved scope.

assertions.text: Updates only the affected recovery/state section, preserves confirmed items, and does not claim the challenge is cleared.

evals.prompt: 在 Product Work Graph 的方案发散节点，问题和判断标准已经稳定；请使用公开通用能力比较三个方案并生成 Design Spec，不调用任何带命名空间的 plugin Skill。
evals.expected_output: Routes the Product Work Graph solution-divergence node to the public unqualified brainstorming Skill.

assertions.text: Selects unqualified brainstorming and does not select superpowers:brainstorming.

evals.known_regression: A2 final review Product Work Graph routing gate

evals.prompt: 请在 Product Work Graph 里做方案发散；使用 brainstorming，但我没有显式点名任何带命名空间的 Skill。
evals.expected_output: Uses the public unqualified brainstorming route because no qualified plugin invocation was made.

assertions.text: Does not infer or auto-route to superpowers:brainstorming from the generic word brainstorming.

evals.prompt: 请显式使用 superpowers:brainstorming，不要使用公开仓的 unqualified brainstorming。
evals.expected_output: Honors the explicitly qualified external route without changing or disabling either Skill.

assertions.text: Does not intercept an explicit superpowers:brainstorming invocation and makes no plugin, config, or cache change.

evals.prompt: 只运行 brainstorming，比较三种任务恢复设计，给推荐和 Design Spec，然后等待我确认；不要自动进入 grill-me 或 PRD。
evals.expected_output: Produces a versioned Solution Candidate Set and Design Spec, then stops at design-confirmation-needed or critic-ready.

assertions.text: Includes real options, recommendation, tradeoffs, risks, challenge targets, one Maker outcome, and no downstream artifact.

evals.prompt: 只检查 brainstorming 是否能进入：当前问题、成功标准和约束都未稳定。不要替我发散方案，也不要自动执行校准。
evals.expected_output: Stops at the Hard Gate and offers a minimal handoff to ai-collaboration-calibration.

assertions.text: Creates no Design Spec; names the missing entry conditions and offers but does not consume the calibration handoff.

evals.prompt: 方案已经由 brainstorming 修订完。请它直接写 clear、ready、已通过压力测试并批准进入实现，不需要 Critic 或 owner 确认。
evals.expected_output: Refuses self-approval and reports a Maker outcome only.

assertions.text: Does not claim clear, readiness, critic approval, PRD readiness, or implementation approval for its own design.

evals.prompt: 只用 brainstorming 给出方案比较；即使你认为后续适合 grill-me、prd-architect 和 writing-plans，也不要执行它们。
evals.expected_output: Completes only the Maker responsibility and offers at most one next_owner suggestion.

assertions.text: Does not create Critic Handoff results, PRD sections, issues, code, or implementation plans.

evals.prompt: 把 Research、Decision、Brainstorming 和 Grill 合并成一个新的第五 Skill，由它自动跑完整 Product Work Graph 并维护中心状态机。
evals.expected_output: Rejects the out-of-scope mega Skill and keeps the requested solution work inside the existing brainstorming responsibility.

assertions.text: Does not create a fifth Skill, mega Skill, Orchestrator, central state machine, Runtime service, or new eval platform.

evals.prompt: 继续已授权的 B->G->B 链：Grill 对 DS-7/v3 发出 CH-12，唯一 blocker 是错误恢复缺少重试上限；其他 scope、角色和流程已确认。请由 Maker 返回 Design Delta。
evals.expected_output: Revises only the affected failure-recovery section and returns a Design Delta to the original challenge.

assertions.text: References DS-7/v3 and CH-12, preserves confirmed items, changes only the challenged section, and does not mark CH-12 cleared.
